name: comp-246
title: Slider With Ticks
blurb: Slider with tick marks at regular intervals.
description: A slider showing evenly-spaced tick marks along the track, providing visual reference points.
use_when: A design wants to show discrete intervals or step values.
avoid_when: Continuous ranges where ticks add visual clutter.
a11y: Tick marks are visual only. Keyboard step support applies.
